newsitem.title: USA: Fed policymakers open meeting on US interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Fed policymakers open meeting on US interest rates.

text.p: Federal Reserve policymakers began meeting on Wednesday to consider interest-rate strategy amid fresh indications of muted inflation that analysts said meant little pressure for a rate rise.
The U.S. central bank's Federal Open Market Committee started meeting at 9 a.m. (1400 GMT) and was expected to announce its decision on rates around 2:15 p.m. (1915 GMT).
Shortly before the meeting began, the Labor Department said wholesale prices rose a moderate 0.4 percent in October. Excluding food and energy, prices fell 0.3 percent last month.

"I would expect the Fed to take no action for both the November and December meetings," said Philip Orlando, chief investment officer at Value Line Asset management. "Inflation is not out there with this number."
